nodes.description: Public address state variable 'owner' storing the deployer/owner address used for access control.
Public uint state variable 'last_completed_migration' recording the highest completed migration index.
Constructor that initializes 'owner' with msg.sender at deployment time.
Public function setCompleted(uint completed) guarded by the 'restricted' modifier; writes 'last_completed_migration'.
Modifier 'restricted' that only continues execution when msg.sender equals owner (access-control gate).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used in the constructor assignment and in the restricted modifier check.
Parameter 'completed' of setCompleted(uint), supplied by the caller and stored in state.
State write 'owner = msg.sender' in the constructor, which fixes the privileged owner address.
State write 'last_completed_migration = completed' inside setCompleted, persisting caller-supplied data.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted caller address that is written into the privileged owner assignment.
The constructor assignment defines the owner state variable that later gates privileged functions.
The constructor executes the owner = msg.sender assignment during deployment.
msg.sender value reaches the owner state variable, establishing the access-control principal.
The restricted modifier reads the owner state variable to authorize the caller.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the restricted modifier's authorization check.
setCompleted applies the restricted modifier, so modifier execution controls entry into the function body.
The parameter 'completed' is bound to setCompleted when the function is invoked.
Caller-supplied parameter 'completed' flows into the state-assignment operation.
setCompleted's body performs the assignment of completed to last_completed_migration.
The assignment writes the caller-supplied value into the last_completed_migration state variable.
Parameter 'completed' is stored directly into the last_completed_migration state variable.
